auth.welcomeTitle: A personal trainer that stays with you all day.
auth.noAccount: New to Rafiq? Create an account
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

me.title: Me
me.scheduleHint: 24-hour time, like 06:30. Your timeline and reminders follow these times.

scheduleErrors.workoutOutsideDay: Pick a workout time between 1 and 15 hours after you wake up.

me.deleteBody: This permanently deletes your account, plans, logs, chats and photos. It can't be undone. If you have a subscription, cancel it in your App Store or Google Play settings first, or it will keep renewing.

language.restartBody: Rafiq needs to restart to switch between left-to-right and right-to-left layout.

welcome.title: Let's build your plan
welcome.body: Three quick steps: about you, your body scan and a short health check. It takes about two minutes.
welcome.noticeBody: Rafiq gives general fitness and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, dietitian or physiotherapist. Stop and get help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.

about.title: About you
about.subtitle: This shapes your training and food plan.
about.name: First name

scan.title: Your InBody scan
scan.subtitle: Upload a photo of your InBody result sheet and we'll read it for you, or type the numbers yourself.
scan.noScan: No scan yet? Leave these empty and we'll use a typical estimate. You can add your scan later.
scan.photoTitle: Read my scan from a photo
scan.photoCamera: Take a photo of the sheet
scan.photoRead: Here's what we read. Check each number against your sheet and correct anything that's wrong.
scan.photoNotRecognised: We couldn't read a body composition sheet in that photo. Try again in good light, or type the numbers.
scan.photoLocked: Reading the sheet from a photo is part of Pro. Try it free, or type the numbers; it only takes a moment.

health.title: Quick health check
health.subtitle: So your plan stays safe. Tick anything that applies.

errors.underage: Rafiq is for adults 18 and over. Younger athletes should train with a qualified coach and a parent.
errors.heightInvalid: Enter a height between {{min}} and {{max}} cm.
errors.weightInvalid: Enter a weight between {{min}} and {{max}} kg.
errors.daysRequired: Choose how many days you can train.
errors.outOfRange: Enter a number between {{min}} and {{max}}, or leave it empty.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your plan. Check your connection and try again.

plan.builtFrom: Built from your scan: {{bodyFat}}% body fat, {{leanMass}} kg lean mass, {{bmr}} kcal resting burn.
plan.builtFromNoCalories: Built from your scan: {{bodyFat}}% body fat, {{leanMass}} kg lean mass.
plan.bodyFatAssumed: We assumed {{bodyFat}}% body fat because no scan was entered. Add your scan for a more accurate plan.
plan.carefulNotice: Because of your health answers, your food plan focuses on regular, balanced meals with no calorie cut. Please check the plan with your doctor before starting.
plan.doctorNotice: Training starts moderate. Get your doctor's or physio's OK, and tell your coach about any pain.
plan.proteinNote: Protein stays at {{protein}} g every day. More carbs on heavy leg days, fewer on rest days.
plan.balancedMeals: Eat regular, balanced meals with protein, vegetables and whole grains at each one.

checkin.title: Morning check-in
checkin.body: Sleep and energy. Your workout adjusts to you.

move.title: Move and drink
move.body: Stand up, 3-minute stretch, 2 glasses of water.

active_recovery.title: Active recovery
active_recovery.body: 30-minute walk. Rest days build the muscle.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.body: 7–9 hours is part of your program.

suhoor.title: Suhoor
suhoor.body: Slow carbs, protein and 2 glasses of water before the fast.

iftar.title: Iftar
iftar.body: Break the fast with 3 dates and water, then your main meal.

checkin.title: Morning check-in
checkin.light: Light day: one less set per exercise and 10% lighter weights. Recovery is training too.
checkin.fresh: You're fresh. Go for a strong session today.

reminders.title: Daily reminders
reminders.body: Get a nudge for your check-in, meals, movement breaks and workout.
reminders.denied: Notifications are off for Rafiq. Turn them on in your phone's settings.

train.restBody: No gym today. A 30-minute walk and good sleep help your muscles grow.
train.lightNotice: Low readiness this morning, so today is lighter: one less set and 10% less weight.
train.checkinNudge: Do your morning check-in on the Today tab and the workout adjusts to how you feel.
train.suggestion: You hit every rep two sessions in a row. Ready for {{kg}} kg?
train.completeBody: Great work. Have your recovery meal within 2 hours. Tomorrow is a {{dayType}}.

history.title: Workout history
history.empty: No workouts logged yet. Your sessions will show up here.

dayNote.high: Heavy training day: carbs fuel your session and refill your muscles.
dayNote.medium: Moderate day: balanced carbs around your workout.
dayNote.low: Rest day: fewer carbs, more healthy fats, same protein.

food.carefulNotice: Your plan uses regular meals without calorie targets. Your coach and a doctor or dietitian can help you go further.
food.loggedMacros: {{kcal}} kcal, {{protein}} g protein, {{carbs}} g carbs, {{fat}} g fat
food.mealAbout: About {{kcal}} kcal, {{protein}} g protein, {{carbs}} g carbs
food.nameRequired: Add a name for the meal.
food.numberInvalid: Enter a number, or leave it empty.
food.aiDescribePlaceholder: e.g. 2 slices of pizza and a cola
food.aiCheck: Check the estimate and edit anything before you add it.
food.aiConfidenceLow: Rough estimate: portion size was hard to judge.
food.aiNotRecognised: That doesn't look like a meal. Try another photo or describe it.
food.aiLocked: Estimating meals from a photo or description is part of Pro.
food.lockedTitle: Carb cycling and meal plans are part of Pro
food.lockedBody: Pro builds your meals around your training days and can read your plate from a photo.

membership.title: Membership
membership.billingIssue: There's a problem with your payment. Update it in your store settings to keep your plan.

coach.greeting: Hi {{name}}! I'm your coach. Ask me anything about today's workout, your meals or how you feel, in any language.
chips: The bench is busy, what can I do instead?
أنا في مطعم الآن، ماذا أطلب؟
Je suis fatigué aujourd'hui, je m'entraîne ?
coach.lockedTitle: Your AI coach is part of Pro
coach.lockedBody: Chat with a coach who knows your plan, your scan and your day, in any language.

errors.bad_request: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.payload_too_large: That photo is too large. Try again with a smaller one.
errors.upgrade_required: This is part of Pro. Try it free from the Me tab.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've reached today's limit for this. It resets tomorrow.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find that photo. Please try again.
errors.ai_refused: I can't help with that one. Try asking another way, or talk to a doctor or physiotherapist.
errors.ai_unavailable: The coach is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.

photoErrors.permission: Rafiq needs access to your camera or photos. You can allow it in your phone's settings.
photoErrors.too_large: That photo is too large. Try again with a smaller one.
photoErrors.upload: We couldn't upload the photo. Check your connection and try again.

paywall.title: Choose your plan
paywall.subtitle: Your AI coach, a program built from your InBody scan, carb cycling and meal plans.
paywall.pending: Your payment is pending. We'll unlock {{plan}} as soon as the store confirms it.
paywall.unavailable: Subscriptions aren't available in this build. They work in store and preview builds of the app.
paywall.legalIos: Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before it ends. You can manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
paywall.legalAndroid: Payment is charged to your Google Play account when you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel in the Google Play Store under Payments and subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

errors.offerings: We couldn't load the plans. Check your connection and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.not_allowed: Purchases aren't allowed on this device or account.
errors.store: The store couldn't complete the purchase. You haven't been charged twice; please try again.
errors.sync: Your purchase went through, but we couldn't update your plan yet. It will update shortly; you can also tap Restore purchases.

pro.name: Pro
features: Training program from your InBody scan
Meal logging by photo or text

elite.name: Elite
features: Monthly review of your plan by a real coach

ramadan.title: Ramadan mode
ramadan.body: Moves meals, water and training around suhoor and iftar. Your coach knows you're fasting.
ramadan.timesHint: Set these to your local fajr and maghrib times (24-hour, like 03:45). Update them every few days as the times shift.

errors.fastOutOfRange: Iftar should be 10 to 18 hours after suhoor.

progress.title: Progress
progress.due: Time for a new scan. A fresh InBody reading keeps your plan matched to your body.
progress.oneScan: Your chart starts after your next scan.
progress.carefulNotice: Your progress here is about how you feel and how your training goes. Your scans are saved, and your coach can talk through them with you.
progress.reminderTitle: Time for your monthly body scan
progress.reminderBody: A new scan keeps your training and nutrition matched to your body.

rescan.title: New scan
rescan.subtitle: Enter your latest InBody numbers. Your plan is rebuilt from them, and your earlier scans stay in your progress history.
rescan.weightRequired: Enter your weight to rebuild your plan.
rescan.keepsHistory: Your goal, training days and health answers stay the same. Your logged workout weights carry on.
rescan.save: Save scan and update my plan

health.body: Rafiq can read your sleep and steps from {{source}}. Your sleep suggests your morning check-in answer, and your coach sees both. Rafiq never writes to {{source}}.
health.manageIos: To remove access, go to Settings › Health › Data Access & Devices › Rafiq.
health.manageAndroid: To remove access, open Health Connect › App permissions › Rafiq.

problems.not_installed: Install Health Connect from Google Play, then try again.
problems.update_required: Update Health Connect from Google Play, then try again.
problems.denied: Rafiq didn't get access. You can allow it in {{source}}.

health.sleepSuggested: {{duration}} of sleep from {{source}}. Change the answer if it doesn't feel right.

review.title: Coach review
review.lockedTitle: A monthly review by a real coach
review.lockedBody: With Elite, a certified coach looks at your month (training, scans, check-ins and food) and writes you a personal review.
review.intro: Ask your coach to review {{month}}. They'll look at your training, scans, check-ins, sleep and food, and write back with what to change.
review.noteLabel: Anything you want your coach to look at?
review.notePlaceholder: e.g. my bench press has stalled
review.consent: Your coach will see your plan, scans, workouts, check-ins, sleep, steps and food logs for this review. Your coach never sees your chats.
review.requested: Your {{month}} review is requested. A coach will pick it up soon, usually within 3 days.

errors.elite_required: Coach reviews are part of Elite.
errors.already_requested: You've already requested this month's review.
errors.failed: We couldn't send your request. Check your connection and try again.

stations.title: Lifting at a smart station?
stations.body: At partner gyms, type the 6-digit code shown on the rack or bench. Your barbell sets then log themselves, with the weight and reps the station measured.
stations.pairedBody: At {{gym}}. Your sets on {{lifts}} are being logged for you. Pairing ends after 20 minutes without a set.

errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Check the 6 digits on the station's screen; codes last 2 minutes.
errors.failed: We couldn't pair. Check your connection and try again.
